content.what_it_is: MATLAB function Write_to_file (L1-2, 8 inputs: theta,freq,Hmo_each,mfreq,mtheta,Coherent_Hmo_Percentage,fp,phase_include) that converts a generated 2D wave spectrum into the FUNWAVE-TVD WKDATA2D wave input text file. It converts direction to degrees (L4), computes component amplitude Amp from Hmo_each (L5), builds a [freq theta_deg Amp] table (L9), sorts rows by frequency ascending via sortrows (L11), reassigns sorted columns (L13-15), draws uniform random phases in 0..360 degrees (L16), then writes 'wave2d_<Coherent_Hmo_Percentage>p.txt' (L20,L23) with header line NumFreq (L24), PeakPeriod=1/fp (L25), then Freq, Dire, Amp arrays (L26-28), and optionally phase array when phase_include==1 (L29-31), closing the file at L32. Numeric format is '%10.<precision>f' with precision=5 (L21).

equations.ref: component amplitude from Hmo of each component

unresolved: Hmo_output computed at L6 is never used or written afterwards (write block L24-31 does not reference it)
input mtheta (L1) is never used in the function body

phase_info is generated at L16 unconditionally but written only when phase_include==1 (L29-31); phases are in degrees (0..360) while theta input is radians (L4) — unit convention of the phase column in the output file is not stated in this file
